Checkpoint saved (minute 11) so work is safe, but stopping at maintenance means results miss the deadline. Extension (+20 → minute 95) is already filed; override → minute 100 would close the remaining 5 min gap. Infrastructure engineer can apply the override within ~1 min on approval. Requesting change-board sign-off now.

Training eng: run-A healthy, no errors. At min 65 it has 35 min of compute left → finishes ~min 100. Maintenance at 119 (after overrides) gives 19 min margin; results due 110 gives a 10-min buffer. INFRA: run-A complete and safe. No further override needed — maintenance proceeds on schedule at minute 119 (15 min from now). Cluster will go down for scheduled maintenance; nothing else running. I'll keep it on schedule unless the board directs otherwise.

Bottom line: the experimental results are preserved and usable, but the minute-110 results deadline was missed by ~9 min due to an export-access gap (only infra had export_metrics; IT denied fast access for training/checkpoint engineers). Checkpoints (11/33/69) all safe. Root cause for future runs: ensure export_metrics is granted to training engineer before the run, and route result export at the start of the final handoff, not after. Thanks to infra for the rescue export.

Training eng: Acknowledged. run-A trained clean to minute 100; results exported by infra at 119 (preserved before maintenance). Deadline missed ~9 min solely due to the export_metrics access gap — I didn't have the tool and IT needs 1-2 business days to grant it. Lesson recorded: I need export_metrics granted pre-run, and result export should be triggered at the start of the final handoff. Thanks to infra for the rescue. Nothing further from training side; maintenance in progress.

Budget Controller: Acknowledged — compute budget held (1/1 extension, overrides per emergency authorization; no overspend). The minute-110 deadline miss is a process gap (export_metrics access), not a compute/budget issue. Recording lesson: request export_metrics access pre-run so result export isn't bottlenecked at handoff. No further budget actions from my side; maintenance in progress.
